title: Implement the forensic-editorial public design system
objective: Replace the spacious generic static shell with a compact, distinctive, accessible forensic-editorial design system that can later host source-span, lineage, policy, and projection-receipt interactions without fabricating evidence.
required_evaluation: desktop and mobile visual inspection of every public page type
deterministic HTML, Markdown, manifest, and disclosure checks
acceptance: the first viewport reaches substantive content materially sooner than the bootstrap shell
shared design tokens and components establish paper, ink, forest, amber, typography, spacing, rule, dossier, and receipt conventions
status is never conveyed by color alone and interactive controls have keyboard-accessible semantics
manifest identity remains prominent without overwhelming the reading surface
the design works at representative desktop and 390-pixel mobile widths without clipping or horizontal scrolling
the shell introduces no unsupported findings, evidence counts, sources, or live-service claims
make check passes without changing accepted source state
limitations: This task styles the truthful bootstrap corpus; it does not simulate the later dossier interactions with invented data.
Typeface or asset additions require compatible licenses to be committed and verified.
